subject.title: Feature: Default outbound topic/thread binding per agent for Telegram

question: Should Telegram add a config-level per-agent outbound topic default, or should proactive sends continue to rely on explicit topic targets and active-context inheritance only?
rationale: The requested fix adds a new Telegram config/default surface and changes visible delivery precedence for proactive forum-group sends, which is a product and compatibility choice rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Add Outbound Topic Defaults
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned outbound default with explicit `threadId` and topic-qualified targets taking precedence, plus docs, regression coverage, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Prefer Active Context Inheritance
options.body: Land or adapt the active-context matcher path so same-chat proactive sends inherit the current topic without introducing a new config key.

options.title: Keep Explicit Routing Only
options.body: Leave routing to explicit `:topic:` targets or per-call `threadId`, and add warnings or docs for ambiguous proactive sends.

recommendation.title: Add Outbound Topic Defaults
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned outbound default with explicit `threadId` and topic-qualified targets taking precedence, plus docs, regression coverage, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing owner for the config/default and message-action threading precedence decision.
